recs.title: Your 10 recommended actions
items: Post the 'If you have it, we buy it' card first (block c), leading with the new Emlid RS4 request (11 Oct), the Trimble SPS930, TX8 and SX12. The TS11 request expired yesterday with no offers, and all 10 live requests are at 0.

Celebrate the FARO Premium 200 sale (Switzerland → USA) with an anonymous 'Sold' post, once Mireille confirms listing #2449 is down. Keep holding the MS60 (Norway → China) until Zein clears the return question.

Send the 12 Oct 'This Week at Topotrade' newsletter today and delete the 28 Sep and 5 Oct drafts. Nothing has gone out since 24 Sep, and the last sends did well (OAGQ: 560 recipients, 13.9% clicks; INTERGEO: 109, 17.4%).

Hold large sends until the DNS fix is confirmed. Zein reported on 12 Oct that @topotrade.com mail is landing in spam (SPF/DKIM/DMARC missing). Odoo campaigns go out through Odoo's own servers, so check with Zein whether they're affected before the newsletter.
Add the 'Intergeo 2026' list (109 contacts) to the weekly newsletter.
Share Zein's WhatsApp broadcast (11 Oct) as a LinkedIn and Facebook post.
Website: GA4 shows 191 users / 310 sessions in the 7 days to 11 Oct (19 users on Sunday). Put UTM tags on every social and newsletter link, because Odoo leads still carry no source or campaign.
Google Ads is still at $0 (card declined on 1 Sep). Have a 'Sell your instrument' + 'Wanted' campaign ready for when billing is fixed.
Instagram is flat (topotrade_ 759 followers, 622 posts; digitalrealities.fr 72). Reuse the sold and wanted cards as Stories. Reach data isn't available through the API.

Digital Realities: a DR buyer collects a Matterport Pro3 in Paris on 15–18 Oct. With Daniel, prepare a post on what DR adds versus Matterport's direct price (stock in France, handover in Paris, scanning services, support), and continue the 3D-scan series (last posts 29 Sep and 5 Oct; GA4 had 0–3 users a day last week).
